name: Atlantic hurricanes
value: No storms; none forecast for 7 days
summary: NHC outlook on 13 Nov expects no Atlantic tropical cyclone formation in the next 7 days; season ends 30 Nov
state: The National Hurricane Center's Tropical Weather Outlook issued at 0523 UTC on 13 Nov says tropical cyclone formation is not expected in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf during the next 7 days (NHC). No storm is active or threatening land, so the signal stays Normal. The Atlantic season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm currently threatens land. Late-season storms are rare but possible until 30 Nov; people travelling to the Caribbean or US Gulf coast can follow the National Hurricane Center and local emergency agencies.
rubric_hit: Normal: no hurricane active and none threatening land within 5 days; NHC expects no formation in 7 days (13 Nov)

sources.title: NOAA National Hurricane Center — Tropical Weather Outlook, Atlantic (13 Nov, 0523 UTC)

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
